people.imagined: Evening in the moulting loft. She has just pressed a thumb to a freshly inked feather roll and is checking the mark against the light from the slats. The hundredth socket in her fan is empty and she has decided, again, that it will stay empty.
people.subject: The moment: late afternoon in a feather loft, she holds a long brown feather up between two fingers of her left hand and studies it with one eye narrowed, while her ink-black right thumb is held up near her cheek. Face (most important: the ink-stained thumb must read large): a broad calm face, skin warm olive and weathered, a few fine lines at the eyes, level dark brows, a straight short nose, a small patient mouth. Her right thumb is stained solid black to the first knuckle. Hair: black with a little grey at the temples, in a plain low knot pinned by a single carved bone pin. Body: small, solid, rounded shoulders, a slight forward lean over her work. Clothing: a cloak sewn from overlapping moulted feathers in tan, brown and a few slate-blue ones, over a practical jungle-green cotton tunic with a crossed collar and plain narrow sleeves; the cloak is clean and neatly stitched. Hands and objects: a half-open round fan in her lap fitted with eighty-one feathers of many kinds, one empty socket at its edge plainly showing as a gap; a short stack of paper rolls tied with cord. Background: blurred wooden loft slats, hanging bunches of drying feathers in warm brown. Light: gold slanting light from the upper left through the slats, with a faint green tint of wood qi in the shadows. Expression: a stubborn, patient face with one eye narrowed against the light and a quiet, unhurried set to the mouth.

people.imagined: Pre-dawn, his bags packed, standing at the loft door at Hà Loan. A small bird is on his shoulder facing the milky eye, which is how he likes it: it does the looking on that side. He is listening to the rain end.
people.subject: The moment: at a loft door in grey pre-dawn, an old aviary hand turns his head so that his clouded left eye faces the viewer, while a small olive-and-yellow bird sits on his left shoulder facing the same way. Face (most important: the clouded eye): a long, lined, sun-browned face; the LEFT eye is entirely milky blue-white with no dark pupil, the right eye is clear brown; thick white eyebrows; a long nose with a flattened tip; a thin straight mouth, short white stubble. Hair: thinning white hair tied in a small knot at the back, a few loose wisps. Body: tall, narrow, stooped, big knuckled. Clothing: a feather cloak of brown and grey moulted feathers, the left shoulder worn smooth where the bird perches; under it a faded moss-green cotton tunic with crossed collar, clean and mended with matching thread; a leather strap across the chest holding a small travel pack. Hands and objects: his right hand is held out palm up with a few seeds in it, a second bird, plain grey, pecking at them. Background: blurred wooden aviary bars, a dim lantern, wet leaves. Light: cool blue dawn from the upper left with a warm pinpoint from the lantern. Expression: a calm, amused face with a clouded left eye and a faint crease of a smile, lids lowered as if listening to the rain end.

people.imagined: Midday on a cinnamon-wood path. She has stopped to rest and the birds have come down without being asked: three on her head, one on each shoulder. She is trying not to laugh in case it scares them.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a mossy log in a cinnamon wood, she holds herself very still with a barely contained grin while five small birds perch on her head and shoulders. Face: a round, open young face, brown skin with a scatter of freckles, big dark eyes bright with delight, short soft brows, a snub nose, a wide mouth pressed shut over a laugh, dimples. Hair: thick black, braided in two short plaits, three small bright birds settled on the crown of her head (a green finch, a yellow warbler and a tiny blue one). Body: slender, young, shoulders hunched with held-in laughter. Clothing: a short feather cape of speckled brown feathers over a pale green cotton tunic with a crossed collar and rolled sleeves; plain brown cord at the waist. Hands and objects: in her lap a small round fan whose frame has four empty sockets, bare ribs showing and no feathers yet; a red-brown bird on her left shoulder and another on her right wrist. Background: blurred cinnamon trunks, dappled light, drifting leaves. Light: warm green-gold light from the upper left, leaf shadows on her cheek, a faint soft green hint of wood qi around the birds. Expression: a barely contained grin with pressed lips, cheeks pushed up and bright eyes shining, shoulders trembling with held-in laughter.

people.imagined: On an empty road at noon, post bag on his hip, he lifts the horn and blows a long note at nobody, then listens to the echo with his head tilted, pleased with it.
people.subject: The moment: on a bare dirt road at noon he puts a brass post horn to his lips and blows it at nothing, eyes closed, cheeks puffed. Face: a young, lean, quick face; tanned; a thin moustache of a few dark hairs; strong straight brows; sharp dark eyes (shut here); a long mobile mouth around the horn. Hair: black, short and tousled, a travelling cap of brown felt pushed back. Body: wiry, a messenger's build, tall and forward on the balls of the feet. Road dust greys his boots and the hem of his tunic. Clothing: a short brown feather cloak with a blue-black collar of feathers; under it a dusty ochre travelling tunic with crossed collar; a wide leather bag across his chest closed with a brass buckle, a small plain brown bird perched on the strap. Hands and objects: a curved brass post horn in his right hand raised to his mouth; a leather gauntlet on his left forearm. The horn's flared bell catches a hard spark of sun, and the small bird on his strap tilts its head at him with polite disbelief. Background: a blurred pale road curling into green hills, a single milestone. Light: bright high noon sun from the upper left, hard shadows under the cap brim. Expression: a broad, cheeky grin pressed around the horn, brows lifted above the shut eyes, the delighted look of a man who thinks the road owes him for the noise.

people.imagined: At the fan bench in lamplight, binding a rib. The fan scorches in her hands again and she looks at it the way one looks at a dog that has done it again, then covers the mark with her thumb.
people.subject: The moment: at a workbench by lamplight, she ties the last cord on a practice fan and looks up sharply as a thread of smoke rises from the paper. Face (most important: the grey streak): a heart-shaped face, pale warm skin, grave dark eyes, firm thin brows, a small straight nose, a closed, guarded mouth; a clear streak of grey hair at the front of a black fringe, wide as two fingers, running from the part down to the left eyebrow. Hair: black, a straight fringe, the rest in a bun low on the neck, bound with a red cord. Body: slim, straight-backed, tense. Clothing: a plain feather vest of dark brown feathers over a fitted tunic in jungle green, with a red thread at the collar; sleeves rolled to the elbow; a leather work apron. Hands and objects: a half-bound fan of dark feathers on bamboo ribs held open before her, one rib charred black at its tip, with a thin curl of smoke; a coil of waxed cord over her wrist. Background: blurred workbench, spools of thread, a hanging row of finished fans. Light: warm lamplight from the left with a flicker of orange at the scorched tip; faint ember-red hint of fire qi in her eyes. Expression: a shut, stubborn face with a tightened jaw and a sharp, annoyed glance, lips pressed against saying anything.

people.imagined: He is carrying a basket up a stairway of roots and has been asked a question he did not hear; he grins first, as always, and then asks for it again.
people.subject: The moment: halfway up a forest stair, a boy hauling a basket turns to the viewer with a wide grin and cups a hand behind one ear. Face: a round young face, sun-brown, wide-set dark eyes with raised brows, a broad flat nose, a big gap-toothed grin showing a missing front tooth, ears sticking out. A fine sheen of sweat shines on his forehead from the climb. Hair: black, cropped short and uneven as if cut with a knife, a tuft standing up at the back. Body: small, stocky, sturdy, bare forearms scratched. Clothing: a short cloak of mottled brown feathers over a faded green cotton jacket with crossed collar, clean and plain; a rope belt. Hands and objects: a tall woven basket with a lid on his back held by a strap across his chest; a few pale wriggling grubs spilled on the lid; his left hand cupped to his ear. A small plain wren sits on the basket's rim. Background: blurred green slope with roots and stone steps, hazy jungle. Pale sunlight filters between the roots, and a thread of mist hangs low on the stair behind him. Light: soft morning light from the upper left, a faint green hint of wood qi on the leaves. Expression: an open, gap-toothed, eager grin, brows high and eyes wide, the face of a boy who will believe whatever he is told next.

people.imagined: Late afternoon on the loft steps with her notebook open on her knee, looking up at the sky because the birds have just gone quiet, and she is about to write it down.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a loft step with a pencil poised, she looks up at the sky over her open notebook, mouth a little open, as the birds have just gone quiet. Face: a narrow thoughtful young face, pale olive skin, large dark serious eyes under long lashes, thin level brows, a small nose with a pencil smudge on its tip, a small pursed mouth. Hair: black, straight, cut to the jaw with a side parting, one side tucked behind the ear. A few fine strands have escaped and stick to her cheek. Body: thin, slightly hunched, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a short brown feather cape over a pale green tunic with crossed collar; narrow sleeves with ink-stained cuffs. Hands and objects: a thin cord around her neck carries a small cloth-covered notebook resting on her chest; a second notebook open on her knee showing rows of tiny drawn bird faces, no letters; a short pencil in her right hand. A silent grey sparrow sits on her shoulder. Her pencil is sharpened to a neat point and her fingers carry a faint grey graphite shine. Background: blurred wooden loft rails, a pale sky. Light: soft diffuse afternoon light, cool green shade with a gold edge from the upper left. Expression: a held breath and a slightly open mouth, brows drawn level, eyes fixed on the silent sky with careful, patient concentration.

people.imagined: In the moulting loft at dusk, she has stopped mid-sentence to look at her fan. Feathers have gathered in her white hair and she does not know. She counts the ninety-nine again.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a bird loft, a stooped old woman holds a large open fan before her and counts its feathers with one finger, unaware of the many feathers nestled in her hair. Face: an old, soft, round face with deep fine wrinkles; faded brown eyes, warm and a little misted; thin pale brows; a small nose; a gentle, slightly open mouth. Hair: white, long, in a loose bun held by a wooden pin, with at least seven small feathers of different colours stuck in it, a blue one, a red, a yellow and some brown. Body: short, stooped, a bent back and thin wrists. Clothing: a long feather cloak of many browns and soft blues, very full, the feathers grown thick at the shoulders; under it a faded blue-grey cotton robe with a crossed collar, clean and soft; a plain cord belt. Hands and objects: a big round fan of ninety-nine feathers in distinct kinds, each differently coloured, spread in a wide round like a sunflower, one empty socket at the very top plainly visible as a dark gap; a blue magpie with one white wing feather perches on her left shoulder. Background: blurred wooden roost poles hung with feathers. Light: low amber light from the upper left, dust motes, a faint green wood qi in the fan. Expression: a soft, tender, faraway face with parted lips and gentle eyes that drift past the viewer, feathers caught in her white hair.

people.imagined: A seal in his fingers at his workbench: he has just closed a letter again and is pleased with the closing, grinning like a man who has won a hand of cards. A bird dropping on each shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: at a post-house table he lifts a freshly closed letter with a red wax seal between finger and thumb and grins at the viewer. Face: a wiry, lined, tanned face, a wide, sly, gap-toothed grin, quick amber eyes with crow's-feet, thin curved brows, a hooked nose, a short pointed goatee in black going grey. Hair: black and grey, a topknot tied with a strip of green cloth, a few strands loose. Body: narrow and quick, stooped shoulders, leaning forward. Clothing: a brown feather cloak with a blue-black collar and, plainly visible, white bird droppings on both shoulders; beneath it a deep green tunic with crossed collar, sleeves rolled; a wide leather belt with a row of small brass bells. Hands and objects: the sealed letter held up in his right hand; on the table by his left, a thin steel knife and a spoon with a warm glowing tip; a grey post pigeon stands on his gauntleted forearm. Background: a blurred wall of pigeonholes full of small rolled letters and a cage of grey birds. Light: warm candlelight from the left, a hint of green wood qi in the bird's feathers. Expression: a sly, delighted grin with raised brows and gleaming eyes, relishing the move like a gambler with a winning hand.

people.imagined: She is inspecting a bundle of fans at the bench and has found a crooked rib. She holds the fan up to the light, one eyebrow raised, deciding whom to complain to.
people.subject: The moment: at a fan-maker's bench, she holds an open fan edge-on to her eye to sight along its ribs, one brow arched, and glares at the viewer over its top. Face: a broad, strong, weathered face; ruddy brown skin; a heavy jaw; sharp black eyes; thick arched brows, the left one raised; a wide, down-turned mouth; laugh lines turned to scowl lines. A sheen of sweat sits on her forehead and upper lip from the brazier heat. Hair: black streaked with grey, pulled tightly into a high knot with two bamboo pins. Body: stout, broad-shouldered, strong forearms. Clothing: a sleeveless feather vest of dark brown over a rust-coloured tunic with crossed collar, sleeves pushed up above the elbow; both bare forearms covered with rows of old pale-pink burn blisters and scars, clearly visible, many rows; a leather apron. The leather apron is dark and supple with use, and the rust-coloured tunic is clean and well cut. Hands and objects: a half-bound fan of dark feathers with one visibly crooked rib in her left hand; a spool of waxed thread on a loop at the wrist. Background: blurred shelves of unfinished fans, bundles of bamboo ribs. Light: warm brazier-orange light from below left, a faint ember hint of fire qi in the shadows. Expression: a heavy-lidded, imperious glare down her nose, one brow cocked and the mouth pulled down at the corners, the look of a woman who already knows the fan is at fault and is choosing whom to blame.

people.imagined: Asleep in the shade, hat over his eyes, hands folded, a row of sticky lime-sticks drying on a rack beside him. A bird has landed on his stomach and is not disturbed.
people.subject: The moment: a man dozing in the shade of a tree, hat tipped over his eyes, one hand lifted lazily to wave off a fly, with a small bird on his chest. Face: a broad, round, easy face, brown and creased, grey stubble, a large nose, a wide relaxed smile in his sleep, a slack lower lip. Both hands in view have a dull yellow-white lime paste on every fingertip, thick and clearly visible. A little drool of sleep shines at the corner of his mouth. Hair: grey, short, mostly hidden under a wide straw hat. Body: heavy, round-bellied, slumped against a trunk. Clothing: a brown feather cloak slung loosely over a faded green cotton tunic with a crossed collar open at the throat; plain trousers; clean cord belt. Hands and objects: in his lap a dozen thin bamboo lime-sticks tied with a string, their tips shining with sticky paste; a small woven cage beside him with a chirping finch. Background: blurred leaf shade, a rack of sticks drying, bright jungle beyond. Behind him a slender rack of drying sticks leans against the trunk, and a patch of sunlit leaves glows bright green. Light: dappled green-gold shade from the upper left, a faint warm green hint of wood qi. Expression: a slack, blissful half-smile with the jaw loose and the brows smooth, the face of a man who has never once been in a hurry.

people.imagined: Dawn in the hidden loft. She has whistled and nine red-crested birds come down to her arms, and she is so proud that she has not noticed the whistle has left a dent in her lip.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn inside a small dim loft, she has just whistled and red-crested birds have landed around her, some on her arms and shoulders and some on a perch before her; she looks at them with shining pride. Face (most important: the red dent in her lower lip): a pale, narrow, shy face; large dark eyes; thin brows; a small nose; her lower lip carries a clear, deep red indent in its centre, the mark of the whistle, a round dent the size of a bean. Hair: black, long, in a simple braid over one shoulder tied with a red thread. Body: slight, tall, standing very straight. Clothing: a clean dark-brown feather cloak with a deep-blue collar; over a jungle-green tunic with crossed collar, narrow sleeves; a small brass key on a cord at her chest. Hands and objects: a thin bone whistle between two fingers of her right hand; both forearms in leather gauntlets with birds on them, birds with scarlet crests and brown backs. Background: blurred small loft with a single high window, a wooden door. Light: pale pink dawn light from the upper left, a faint soft green hint of wood qi on the birds. Expression: loyal, solitary, certain she has been given an honour.

people.imagined: Dusk on the ridge: she is mid-song, head thrown back, throat full, and the birds are streaming home above her. She is entirely at ease with how big her voice is, and she does not look at anyone below her.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a ridge she sings with head thrown back and chin raised, mouth wide open, as a dozen small post birds spiral in toward her raised arm. Face: an oval, striking young face; warm tan skin; a strong chin; large dark eyes half-closed; arched brows; a wide open mouth in song showing white teeth; a small pert nose. A flush of effort warms her cheeks and the tendons of her throat stand out as she sings. Hair: dark brown, long, loose and windblown, with a single orange feather tucked behind one ear. Body: sturdy and tall for her age, broad shoulders, a deep chest, planted feet. Clothing: a feather cloak of tan and speckled brown with a gold-yellow collar, thrown open in the wind; under it a bright apricot cotton tunic with a crossed collar and a green sash. Hands and objects: her right arm thrust up in a leather gauntlet, a small brown bird hovering at the wrist; the left hand pressed against her breastbone. Background: blurred orange dusk sky, dark ridge, birds as dark specks. Light: low rosy-gold sunset from the upper left, a gentle green hint of wood qi on the birds. Rose-gold edges rim every windblown strand of her hair. Expression: a bold, glowing, open-throated joy, chin high and eyes half shut, entirely certain that the sky was made to hear her.

people.imagined: Reading over his master's shoulder in the post-house, trying to look as if he is not. His left ear, always pink from the sun, is turned toward the page like a dish.
people.subject: The moment: in a post-house, a young man leans on a doorframe with his arms folded, his head tilted so that his left ear points toward something unseen, his eyes sliding sideways at the viewer. Face (most important: the permanently pink ear): a narrow, pale, guarded face; his left ear is a strong, bright sunburnt pink, much redder than the rest of his skin, and sticks out clearly; narrow grey-brown eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; thin lips tight in a half-smile. A faint shine of sweat sits at his temple, and a small mole shows beneath the right eye. Hair: black, combed flat and tied low, tidy. Body: wiry, medium height, shoulders slightly forward. Clothing: a short dark-brown feather cloak with a collar of blue-grey feathers over a clean slate-green tunic with crossed collar; a wide belt with a small brass buckle. Hands and objects: a brown post bird on his folded forearm, a leather riding glove on the other hand tucked in his armpit. Background: blurred wall of pigeonholes, an out-of-focus lamp. Rows of small wooden pigeonholes stacked with rolled slips climb the wall behind him. Light: cool white light from a window at upper left, hard on the pink ear. Expression: a thin, closed half-smile with the eyes sliding sideways, the careful blankness of a man who is reading what he was not asked to read.

people.imagined: A raft-village cage-maker sitting at his bench weaving, swaying slightly with the memory of water even on dry land, charging double for what he was told not to ask about.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stool at a weaving bench, an old man holds a half-woven wicker cage frame and sways gently from side to side, as if on a raft, eyes on his own hands. Face: a long, weathered face the colour of old rope; deep vertical wrinkles; a drooping grey moustache; small, shrewd, pale-brown eyes with heavy lids; a long straight nose; a thin, closed mouth with a tight sly corner. Hair: thin grey hair tied in a short queue, a river-blue headcloth knotted on top. Body: lean and wiry, bent forward, long strong fingers, sinewy forearms. Clothing: a plain undyed hemp jacket with crossed collar and wide sleeves, fine and clean, dyed river-blue at the cuffs; plain trousers; a woven reed belt; no feather cloak, as he is a servant, not a keeper. Hands and objects: a half-woven cage of pale reeds with nine ribs, one cut reed held in his teeth; a bundle of cut reeds on his lap; a small iron knife with a bone handle tucked behind his ear. Background: blurred workshop with hanging finished cages, bundles of cane, a slice of green water light. Light: soft grey daylight from the upper left, a hint of dull steel-grey metal qi at the knife. Expression: reclusive, pragmatic, money-minded; a man who has decided his silence is worth double.

people.imagined: The founder, old, high on Triều Phượng Đỉnh at dawn, as he climbs every spring. He stands with his staff and looks down the slope at the birds in the wind below, waiting to see whether they bow.
people.subject: The moment: a weathered old catcher stands on a summit at dawn leaning on a staff, gazing out and slightly down to his right with an expression of hope; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: long, lean, brown, deeply lined; a long white beard to mid-chest, thin and wispy; shaggy white brows over keen pale eyes; a high forehead; a gentle, slightly open mouth. Weather has chapped his cheekbones to a deep brown and fine white hairs grow along the edges of his ears. Hair: long white hair worn loose with a headband of plaited bark. Body: tall, rangy, narrow, leaning on a staff taller than he is, bare calves. Clothing: a plain long coat of undyed hemp sewn all over with small moulted feathers in brown and blue, simple and neat; a rope belt hung with small bird calls of carved wood; no jewellery. Hands and objects: a tall rough wooden staff with a carved bird at its top, in both hands; a single feather in his headband. Background: a faded pale sky, a ridge, small distant birds like commas wheeling in a spiral. Light: low pale dawn light from the upper left. The silk-painting fade turns the whole palette to soft ochre, grey-green and bone. Expression: a tender, hopeful look, brows lifted and lips just parted, the gentle gaze of an old man waiting to see whether the birds will bow.

people.imagined: A Hà Loan netter at the edge of the dark forest with his net over his shoulder, taking one more step in, with a look of ease, as if the forest had always been kind.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a dark jungle he turns to look back with a broad trusting smile, a long net slung over one shoulder; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad square sunburnt face; thick black moustache; big warm brown eyes; heavy straight brows; a wide easy mouth. Hair: black, tied in a short topknot with a hemp string. A few grey strands show at the temples and a short fringe has escaped the string onto his forehead. Body: broad, muscular, a middle-aged netter's frame. Clothing: a sleeveless brown jerkin of tough hide over a grey-green hemp shirt with crossed collar; rolled sleeves; a plain cord belt; no feather cloak. Hands and objects: a long fine net rolled over his left shoulder with a few bright green parrot feathers caught in it; in his right hand a short wooden pole with a hook. Background: faded dark green wall of tall trees and a single shaft of light. Behind him the trees stand in layered dark greens, one pale trunk catching the light, with a faint curl of mist along the ground. Light: soft low light from the upper left, a little warm. Expression: content, brave, trusting, unafraid. No fear at all, only the open ease of a man to whom the forest has always been kind.
